course_name_original: Simulación Numérica de Materiales, Componentes y Estructuras
course_name_en: Numerical Simulation of Materials, Components and Structures

learning_outcomes.text: Know the contents developed in the module.
Know the numerical methods and models for the analysis of materials, components and structures.
Acquisition of skills and work methodology to simulate the mechanical behavior of different materials and evaluate their durability.
Know and apply predictive models capable of extrapolating the behavior of systems, structures and components for a defined period of use.
Numerically simulate, using specialized software, the behavior of materials and apply these models to the evaluation of the structural integrity of components and structures.
Write a scientific paper concisely and present it orally with clarity.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to numerical simulation of materials, components and structures.
Analysis stages: Pre-processing, analysis and post-processing.
Numerical simulation in linear elastic fracture mechanics.
Numerical simulation in elastoplastic fracture mechanics.
Numerical simulation of crack propagation. Development of macros.

assessment_methods.method: Set of exercises and practices (minimum grade of 4 out of 10 points)
Group work reports, presentation and debate (minimum grade of 4 out of 10 points)
Written exam on course content (minimum grade of 4 out of 10 points)

assessment_rules: A set of exercises and practices will be proposed, which must be submitted (minimum grade of 4 out of 10 points), accounting for 40% of the final grade. Another 20% of the final evaluation will correspond to the group work reports along with their presentation and debate (minimum grade of 4 out of 10 points). Finally, a written exam on the course content will be held, accounting for the remaining 40% of the final grade (minimum grade of 4 out of 10 points).
